text:
nisha: noticed a latent bug in canary: when we rotate quant profiles during a live workload, some KV cache entries get applied with mismatched scale vectors and outputs skew slightly. reproducible on longctx runs.
leo: yikes. seen a couple of customer reports with subtle bias drift mid-conversation. logs show `apply_kv: scale_version != active` occasionally.
ari: probable cause: we only swap profile pointer, but cached KV blobs don't carry profile provenance. simple fix: attach `profile_id` + `scale_ver` to each KV entry.
nisha: agree. but attaching metadata increases cache size slightly. tradeoff? we could compress header to 8 bytes: 4b profile hash + 4b version.
leo: 8 bytes is fine. bigger concern: race during swap where some workers reference old profile and others new -> mixed application. need atomic swap and eviction strategy.
ari: propose: loader reads new profile into memory, validates CRC, then do CAS on `active_profile_ptr`. workers will check entry.profile_id == active.profile.hash before apply; mismatch -> skip and request recompute or fetch fallback.
nisha: skipping will add latency for that token. maybe instead mark entry as stale and re-encode with new profile asynchronously. fallback path: if mismatch and model config `force_evict_on_swap=true` then evict immediately.
leo: add hysteresis: only force-evict when mismatch ratio > 0.01% over 5m window to avoid unnecessary churn on small flips.
ari: tests: unit test for hot-swap during interleaved requests, and a shadow replay to verify no >0.5% regression in top1 token on seeded prompts.
ops-bot: canary-note: quant-hot-swap v1 deployed to shadow with tag `kv.prov=true` at 11:04 UTC.
leo: telemetry: add `kv.profile_mismatch` counter + sample exporter that captures offending request id (hashed) at 1/10k rate. no PII.
nisha: API: add optional model flag `profile_opt_in` default false for hosted so customers opt in to experimental fp8 profiles. private customers can opt in via config.
ari: also propose a runtime lint that validates incoming profile compatibility (layer counts, dtype support) before swap and rejects incompatible profiles with clear error.
leo: quick pseudocode for apply check: ```py
entry = kv_cache.get(key)
if entry.profile_hash != active.profile.hash:
  telemetry.count('kv.profile_mismatch')
  if cfg.force_evict_on_swap:
    kv_cache.evict(key)
    return recompute()
  else:
    return recompute()
else:
  apply(entry)
```
nisha: action items: nisha -> spec header format + docs; leo -> telemetry + mismatch dashboard; ari -> implement CAS loader + unit tests; ops -> run 72h shadow with small cohort.
ari: note: also watch for perf impact on memory; we should measure cache hit rate change after header added.
